name: Wise Guys | 1g Live Resin 510 Cartridge | Sherb Cream Pie
description:
Cross/Lineage: Ice Cream Cake x Sherb BX1

Flavor: Funky gas terps with mild rotting fruit undertones

Type/Leaning: Hybrid (Balanced)

Experience live resin the way it’s meant to be. Our 510 carts feature a premium ceramic heating element with a full glass casing for clean, smooth, and flavorful hits every time. We never cut our live resin with distillate, and we use little to no CRC in the process—so what you’re tasting is the real deal: pure, terpene-rich cannabis exactly as it should be.
